[[Koumei]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for core and Factions professions using the Elite [[Canthan armor]] art. Koumei also crafts [[Elementalist headgear#auras|Elementalist auras]]. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]]. Fellow armorers [[Wei Qi]] and [[Maiya]] can be found next to Koumei.
